author: Microsoft Corporation

files.used: FileStream HANDLE ownership, COM identity/reference counting, Read/Write/Seek/Stat structure

changes: Accept and duplicate an existing identity-checked CRT file object instead of reopening/truncating a filename.
Use serialized 64-bit logical positions and bounded CopyTo; Clone shares the open object with an independent position.
Implement SetSize and FlushFileBuffers-backed Commit for the existing MF MP4 muxer; preserve optional unsupported direct-stream transaction/region-lock semantics as explicit errors.
Validate pointers, EOF/short writes, file kind, allocations and sizes; initialize all STATSTG fields.
notClaimed: This file-object adapter is not a codec, container implementation, filesystem sandbox or hardware recording acceptance.
